Jag hittade vägen på kartan.en: I found the way with a map.

texto: Narrating an event, placing it and closing it with a reflection. **Jag hittade vägen på kartan** means «I found the way with a map.». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 2 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
